status: REFERENCE_PREPARATION_COMPLETE; NEW TRAINER NOT IMPLEMENTED OR LAUNCHED
human_instruction: Why are we limiting PPO to three tiny movements? Can we train full sitting and leaning with demonstrations and staged rewards instead, while letting the current comparison finish?
authorization_interpretation: Prepare a separate simulation-only demonstration-guided full-movement experiment. Broaden the new policy's action representation; preserve the live comparison and its frozen action limits, rewards, resource allocation and physical criteria. No hardware deployment, holdout access, old solver restart or recurring automation.

why_current_actions_are_narrow.purpose: Controlled residual-repair pilot around best09, aimed at preserving64 clean cases while trying to repair8 failures.
why_current_actions_are_narrow.action: Three bilateral hip/knee/ankle pitch corrections, each limited to0.004rad, chosen every0.5s after6s.
why_current_actions_are_narrow.limitation: Cannot independently choose left/right leg motions, torso or arm strategy, or replace the early movement. This is a controller-design restriction, not a PPO restriction.
why_current_actions_are_narrow.causality: We have not proved that these limits make repair impossible. Some limited-action noisy episodes have succeeded on some failure conditions. Wider control is a new hypothesis, not a demonstrated cure.
why_current_actions_are_narrow.prior_broader_work: Historical23-action bounded residual and two-surface curriculum studies already exist. Merely widening another residual layer would not implement this new approach.

new_policy_design.method: Separate task-conditioned PPO actor for complete sitting/leaning movements, guided by motion references; task code selects sit or lean. Independent per-joint commands replace the stack of frozen parent corrections.
new_policy_design.outputs: 23 independent nonfinger joint position targets in the existing robot model.14 finger joints remain fixed. No forced bilateral symmetry or three-channel residual projection.
new_policy_design.action_mapping: Use validated per-joint position ranges, torque/velocity protections and a tested command-rate limiter. A reference trajectory supplies a training target, not an immutable motor command. Final numeric ranges and rate limits must be frozen after source/asset checks; they are not copied from a29-DoF research robot.
new_policy_design.inputs: Sensor history, estimated surface pose/normal and validity, task command, desired motion/phase goal and previous action. Simulator truth contacts and exact surface pose are reward/evaluation labels only. No geometry-ID lookup policy.
new_policy_design.initialization: Motion-tracking PPO with reference-state practice, then full standing-start rollouts. Behavior cloning is optional only after correctly aligned pre-action observations and applied commands have been collected. Current10Hz records are not a behavior-cloning dataset.
new_policy_design.demonstration_generalization: Use demonstrations as a soft motion prior. Reduce rigid pose tracking once task learning works so the actor can adapt to new surfaces; preserve legality and task-completion requirements. Retargeted public demonstrations can add diversity after model/frame/license checks, but none have been imported.

motion_phases.reward: Progress toward a surface-relative approach pose, balanced motion and demonstration tracking; no reward for merely waiting near the surface.
Progress toward the intended legal contact patch, low closing speed and gentle load onset; penalize hip-housing and other forbidden contacts.
Transfer load to permitted surfaces while reducing loaded-contact slip and body motion. Slip severity must remain distinguishable after crossing the pass threshold.
Continuous valid supported rest for5s. Only then reward lower effort; effort savings must not qualify a failing trial as successful.

curriculum: Practice final supported hold from validated contact/reset states.
Move the training starts backward to contact and settling, retaining some full-start rollouts.
Train the complete standing-to-sit or standing-to-lean movement; remove dependence on reference-state starts in final evaluation.
Vary only the development surface/start conditions initially. Evaluate all72 original sitting cases and a separately frozen leaning development bank.
reward_validation_before_training: Freeze formulas, normalization, weights, phase transitions and maximum reward contributions before an experiment.
Check saved successful and failed episodes: worse slip or forbidden contact must not earn a better contact component; positive hold/effort reward is disabled when its contact requirements fail.
Check empty-contact, contact loss, phase jumping, repeated-contact reward farming, no-motion and terminal/reset edge cases.
Compare task results separately from imitation fit and aggregate reward. No claim that a weighted reward guarantees strict success.

prepared_data.missing_for_direct_cloning: Aligned full-rate actor observations/actions and complete velocities/reset state. Do not fabricate them from downsampled poses.
prepared_data.leaning_scope: The existing leaning examples cover the recorded supported-contact configuration, not every wall/back/hand support behavior. Contact-patch coverage must be explicit in the new task definition.

execution_order: Finish the existing128-update original/revised comparison on both seeds with its queued audits and72-case evaluations unchanged.
Prepare the new environment adapter, reward functions, reference loader, contact-phase observer and logging in a separate source directory; do not edit sources loaded by the live jobs.
After comparison workers have exited, validate reset/command/contact semantics and revalidate leaning references at full control rate in a bounded preflight.

Freeze the audited sources, inputs, initialization, seeds, training/evaluation budget and resource limits. Then launch the separate demonstration-guided pilot and verify actual actor/critic weight and optimizer updates.

resource_status.current_preparation: Local CPU only;27 completed sitting input files copied,82 motion records packaged and checked. Zero new simulator or optimizer steps.
resource_status.required_budget_accounting: Include demonstration recollection, reset warmup, tracking pretraining, PPO, all evaluations, simulator substeps, retries (none automatic), CPU audits, rendering, model/checkpoint storage and total wall time. Determine throughput with a bounded preflight before choosing the final update count.

acceptance.sitting: Report strict clean completion on every full20s development trial, repairs among the original8 and regressions among the protected64. A candidate is not promoted if it loses a protected case.
acceptance.leaning: Freeze a separate development bank and evaluate complete standing-start transitions with the same physical checks and5s valid hold; sitting results do not establish leaning success.
acceptance.heldout: Fresh24 sitting holdout remains closed until selection. Any new leaning heldout split must be sealed before development training.
acceptance.unchanged_physical_criteria: No relaxation of slip, forbidden contact, fall, impact, torque, joint-limit or continuous-hold requirements.
acceptance.current_physical_success_claim: None. Best09 remains the accepted64/72 baseline; no new repairs were produced by reference preparation.
